The 49th Tamil Nadu State Film Awards for the best talents of the year 2015 was announced on 5 March 2024. The Awards were presented to the winners on 6 March 2024, on Rajarathinam Kalai Arangam, Chennai.
Superlatives
Most Wins (Films)
*  6 Wins: Thani Oruvan, 36 Vayadhinile
*  4 Wins : Irudhi Suttru
*  3 Wins : Pasanga 2
Most Wins (Individuals)
* Suriya - 2
Winners
Awards
All award recipients receive a certificate, medal and statuette.
